narr: A third day of very deep moisture across the Borderland brought heavy rain to the Canutillo area and additional flash flooding after 5 to 7 inches of rain fell in the previous 3 days.
ev: Multiple reports of flash flooding in Canutillo due to 5 to 7 inches of rainfall in the region over the previous days. A stalled vehicle needed to be rescued near the Family Dollar on Doniphan Drive. Texas Highway 20 was closed again due to water and debris across the road.
